noAgency.title: Your account is not linked to an agency yet
noAgency.body: The {brand} team links each account to its agency when it is set up. If you are seeing this, write to us and we will finish it.

pool.title: Talent pool
pool.intro: Verified candidates who are available now. You see what you need to decide; their full name, contact details and documents stay with the candidate until they give you permission.
pool.results: {count, plural, =0 {No candidates} one {# verified candidate} other {# verified candidates}}
pool.empty: No candidate matches these filters. Try removing one.

card.activeDaysAgo: Active {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago

notFound.title: This candidate is no longer in the pool
notFound.body: They may have paused their profile or become unavailable. The pool only shows candidates who are verified and active today.

facts.title: Profile
facts.workedAbroad: Has worked in Germany or the Netherlands

candidate.experienceNote: Written by the candidate, in their language.
candidate.noExperience: The candidate has not described their experience.

verified.title: Checked by {brand}
verified.body: Each seal means someone at {brand} checked the original document. You see that it exists and was checked, not the document itself.

private.title: What stays with the candidate
items: Full surname, email and phone number.
Their documents: ID, passport, CV, licence and tax papers.
Their IBAN and address, which only the agency that hires them sees.

contact.title: Contact this candidate
contact.body: Send a first message. The candidate decides whether to reply; their contact details stay hidden until you hire them.
contact.template: Hello {name}, we have a warehouse job that could suit you, with transport to work included. Would you like to hear more?
contact.existing: You already have a conversation with this candidate.

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.empty: No conversations yet. Open a profile in the talent pool and write to the candidate.
inbox.pendingNote: The candidate has not accepted yet. You can write again once they accept.
inbox.maskedNote: Contact details are hidden until you hire the candidate.
inbox.hireNote: Hiring reveals the candidate's full name, phone, email, ID, CV and English audio recording, and their messages without hidden details.

hireConfirm.title: Request the details?
hireConfirm.body: Only request the details once you are sure you will hire this person. From that moment they count as hired, and the fee for this person becomes payable.
